insert:
## Who should buy a mini bar fridge

A mini bar fridge suits renters, students, home offices and anyone who wants cold drinks without a full-size fridge. It is also a good second fridge for a games room. If you entertain often or serve customers, a larger bar fridge from our [bar fridge range](/bar-fridges/) will serve you better. Decide how many drinks you really need to chill at once before you choose.

before: ## Buying a black bar fridge online
insert:
## Black bar fridge sizes and layouts

Black models come as under bench units, tall upright cabinets and wide back bar designs. Think about whether the fridge will be built in or freestanding, and how the door opens. In a tight layout, a sliding door or a reversible hinge saves space. If you are matching several appliances, check that the black shades are close, because different makers use different tones.

before: ## Buying a back bar fridge online
insert:
## Choosing between brands

Several makers supply back bar fridges to Australian venues, including Skope, Bromic and Tefcold. You can browse their ranges from our [brands pages](/brands/skope/). Compare the warranty, the parts supply and the build quality as well as the price, because a bar fridge works hard every night of the week.
